method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); two regulative rules (the Secretary's three days to apply after a removal, s 13(2); the Tribunal's further consideration within an interim financial management order's period, s 25H(3)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Guardianship Act 1987 No 257 (NSW), corpus document nsw_legislation:2021-03-27/act-1987-257 from the Open Australian Legal Corpus (collected 10 March 2025; unofficial, possibly out of date), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1987-257.txt

seat: the person with a disability: the adult (or young person of 16 or 17) who appoints an enduring guardian, about whom a guardianship or financial management order is sought or made, who is removed from premises under ss 11-13, or on whom medical or dental treatment is proposed

scope: In: Part 1 definitions (ss 3(1), 3(2), 3D, 3E); Part 2 enduring guardians, whole (ss 5-6O); Part 3 guardianship orders (ss 9, 13(2), 14, 15, 16(1)(a), 17, 18, 21A(2), 23, 25-25C); Part 3A financial management (ss 25F-25I, 25K, 25M(2)-(3), 25N(4), 25O-25R); ss 30, 31F; Part 5 medical and dental treatment, whole operative Part (ss 33-37, 44-47); s 48B; s 80A; ss 100, 101. Out: machinery (ss 1, 2, 3(3)-(6), 48, 77-80, 98, 106-109, Schedule 3), s 4 principles, s 3F parties, service and notice duties, Tribunal and court powers that give the seat no question, offences in ss 102-105. Reasons in NOTES.md.
